verdict.rationale: The sign-in method is a fair question for a government digital-administration portal, so the axis applies. However, the evidence only shows that ANEF serves a ~3 KB JavaScript shell and that every transaction sits behind an account. It says nothing about whether sign-in uses remotely completable credential MFA or relies on biometric, in-person, or mailed-PIN steps. The Cloudflare challenge on the parent ministry site concerns agent access, not the human sign-in path.
